title: Lithophane - test_photo
description:
Lithophane of 'test_photo' — 240x180 px photo converted to 3D.

Dimensions: 156.8 x 117.6 x 3.2 mm, wall thickness 0.8-3.2 mm with reinforced border.
How to use: print in white/translucent filament at 100% infill, then light it from behind (LED panel or strong backlight) to reveal the image.
Recommended: 0.1 mm layers. No supports.
Archive contains model.stl.
